RegisterConfigForm.save_error: An error occurred while saving registration settings.

join.title: Register Join Channel
join.description: The channel where a message will be sent when a user joins the server. This is for registration purposes.
join.label: Select Channel

register.title: Register Channel
register.description: Only allows registration commands to be used in this channel.
register.label: Select Channel

message.title: Register Message
message.description: The registration message that will be sent when a user joins the server.
message.label: Message Content

ModerationConfigForm.save_error: An error occurred while saving moderation settings.

mod_logs_channel_id.title: Moderation Log Channel
mod_logs_channel_id.description: The channel where moderation actions will be logged.
mod_logs_channel_id.label: Select Channel

staff_role_id.title: Staff Role
staff_role_id.description: The role that has permission to use moderation commands.
staff_role_id.label: Select Role

mod_mail_channel_id.title: Mod Mail Channel
mod_mail_channel_id.description: The channel where mod mail logs will be sent. The mod mails also show up in the same parent category as this channel.
mod_mail_channel_id.label: Select Channel

mute_get_all_roles.title: Mute Get All Roles
mute_get_all_roles.description: When muting a user, the bot will remove all their roles and store them to restore later.
mute_get_all_roles.label: Enable

days_to_kick.title: Days to Kick
days_to_kick.description: Number of days a user can go unverified before they are automatically kicked from the server. Set to 0 to disable automatic kicking.
days_to_kick.label: Days

default_expiry.title: Default Expiry for Warnings
default_expiry.description: Number of days after which warnings expire by default. Set to 0 for no expiry.
default_expiry.label: Days

username.label: Username
username.detail: The user's display name, e.g. Khaxy

server_name.label: Server Name
server_name.detail: The server's name, e.g. My Server

member_count.label: Member Count
member_count.detail: Total members in the server, e.g. 150

join_position.label: Join Position
join_position.detail: User's join position in the server, e.g. 149

created_ago.label: Account Age
created_ago.detail: Human-readable account age, e.g. 2 years ago
